props.name: children
props.description: The region’s content. Its elements are the occluders, measured from the live layout.

props.name: lights
props.description: Controlled lights. Positions are fractions of the region, so they survive resizes.

props.name: onLightsChange
props.description: Called with the new lights whenever one is dragged, nudged with the keyboard or follows the pointer.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Light that reaches everywhere, shadow included, from 0 (black shadows) to 1 (no shadows). Darker on dark themes.

props.name: softness
props.description: Size in pixels of the light’s body: it sets how wide the soft penumbra at a shadow’s edge is. 0 is a point.

props.name: samples
props.description: Jittered positions per light used to build the penumbra, from 1 to 8. More is smoother and costs more.

props.name: layer
props.description: Whether the light falls on the content (`over`) or only on the floor beneath it (`under`).

props.name: occluders
props.description: Selector for the elements that cast shadows. When nothing matches, every direct child casts one.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: The first light follows the pointer while it is over the region.

props.name: motion
props.description: Motion of the lights on their own. Ignored under reduced motion; dragging always works.

props.name: showHandles
props.description: Show the draggable, focusable handles. Without them the lights can only be set by props or `followPointer`.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. The region needs a size and usually a background for shadows to fall on.
